answer: EigenTrust reputation decays exponentially, halving after each configured temporal half-life, so an identity must provide sustained, honest service to build durable trust. Reciprocity-weighted endorsements propagate through the network, but a freshly spawned Sybil has almost no incoming trust and near-zero eigenvector centrality; like a trace of pigment on a terrace, its plume of fabricated identities adds no credible support and cannot pass consensus.
